'''Arron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. For three years he was a neighbor to a woman named [[Nalia]] until she was arrested as the enemy of Zakuul. During the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]] Nalia was put in a [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collar]] with other Zakuulan rebels, who were to be executed by the Empress [[Vaylin]]. Arron treated Nalia as a slave and despite her pleas refused to acknowledge that he even knew her from before. Vaylin's execution of rebels was interrupted by the arrival of first the [[Alliance Commander]] and then former Emperor [[Arcann]]. In an effort to kill them both, Vaylin ordered the [[Eternal Fleet]] to bomb the Palace into rubble, regardless of her supporters still inside.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arron appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during '''"Chapter VI: The Dragon's Maw".'''
